text: Kala arduɗo e moƴƴere Ñalnde Darngal (wano julde, asakal, koorka ekn...) hino woodani mo cowalle nden moƴƴere makko, haa wano sappo yeru maun. Kala kadi arduɗo ton e bononnda (keeferaaku, e ñaamugol rubaa, e jeenugol ekn...) yo o anndu, huuwuɓe bonɗi ɓen yoɓetaake, si wanaa yeru ko ɓe huuwaynoo kon, ko aldaa e ɓeydaneede.
